name: to-do
description: Date-routed daily to-do notes feeding SpaceDailyDashboard's tasks panel under spice/to-do/. v0.4.0 MINOR (v0.116.0): five-section daily-note shape (Capture / Carryover / Recurring / Project Groups / Unassigned Meetings). NEW Recurring Tasks registry at spice/to-do/Recurring Tasks.md (type: to-do-recurring) parsed on render and materialized into today's daily under ## Recurring Today. NEW per-project To-Do note shape (type: project-todo) at spice/projects/<slug>/<Name> To-Do.md (created by the project blueprint v1.22.0 backfill / extra_files). NEW tabbed +New Task dialog (ToDoCreateTask) with One-shot + Recurring modes. NEW palette commands sauce:new-task + sauce:new-recurring-task. NEW helpers: ToDoDailyCarryover (yesterday-only auto-migration into today's note), ToDoDailyRecurring (registry → today materializer), ToDoDailyProjectGroups (live aggregator over project To-Do notes + meeting tasks linked to projects), ToDoDailyUnassignedMeetings (live aggregator over meetings without project: frontmatter), TaskParser (parseTasks extracted from v0.3.3 ToDoMigrateModal), RecurrenceParser (pure recurrence-grammar evaluator covering 4 supported families: daily / weekday-set / day-of-month / every-N-weeks-on-day). RETIRED ToDoMigrateModal + ToDoMigrateInit (the Migrate-to-tomorrow modal is superseded by [scheduled:: YYYY-MM-DD] on the task line + the new tabbed dialog). depends_on +1 entity-create@>=0.5.0 (project list resolution at dialog open-time mirrors meetings@v0.8.0 options_source pattern). Two new schema-registry entries: project-todo (project blueprint-owned) + to-do-recurring (to-do blueprint-owned). Carries forward: v0.3.x All-ToDos hub + backlog aggregator + ToDoLeafActions self-heal posture (all retained; LeafActions extended to 3-button row). v0.5.0 MINOR (workshop v0.117.0): visual polish — replaces every raw ## H2 heading with SectionLabel dataviewjs blocks (small uppercase muted label + hairline divider above; matches project blueprint v1.21.0+ pattern). NEW depends_on: project >=1.21.0 for SectionLabel primitive. Daily-note template now ships a SectionLabel("Today's Capture", top: true) block between LeafActions and ToDoDailyCarryover. Project To-Do + Recurring Tasks templates use SectionLabel for Owned Tasks / From Meetings / Recurring Tasks / Last 7 days headings. ToDoDailyCarryover + ToDoDailyRecurring materialize SectionLabel dataviewjs blocks (not ## H2). ToDoDailyProjectGroups + ToDoDailyUnassignedMeetings call customJS.SectionLabel.render(...) for section labels + render task rows as styled flex blocks (leading checkbox icon + primary task text + muted italic source attribution). applyToDoBlueprintMigration extended to (a) reshape v0.4.0 daily notes to v0.5.0 by inserting the SectionLabel("Today's Capture") block, (b) rewrite persisted ## Carryover/Recurring/Owned/From Meetings/Recurring Tasks/Last 7 days H2 to SectionLabel dataviewjs blocks across daily + project-todo + registry. Fixes v0.116.x bug where Today To-Do.md template was never updated to v0.4.0 shape (only 2 dataviewjs blocks shipped to consumers; sections never rendered). v0.7.0 PATCH+MINOR (workshop v0.119.0): additive sentinel for recurring-materialization (per-task hash set replaces date-only short-circuit; fixes mid-day-added blind spot) + markdown rendering in live-render to-do widgets (ToDoDailyUnassignedMeetings + ToDoDailyProjectGroups now emit <a> elements for [label](url) + [[wikilink]]; previously rendered raw text). NEW applyRecurringSentinelV070Migration heals legacy date-only sentinels in place. v0.8.2 wired todo-create-task's auto-open to read mode via customJS.OpenHelpers. v0.8.3 PATCH (v0.120.3 review): _submit now opens the created/fetched TFile on a captured leaf (getLeaf(false).openFile(file)) and calls window.customJS.OpenHelpers?.forceLeafPreview?.(leaf) — optional-chained for cold-load safety; captured leaf avoids flipping the wrong note if focus moves before the deferred flip. v0.12.0 MINOR (v0.127.0 task-interactions wave): NEW TodayCaptureEditableList CustomJS class renders the daily note's free-form Today checkboxes as a click-to-edit list with per-task metadata chips (project, priority, due, scheduled). Pencil icon on each row invokes ToDoCreateTask.open({ editExisting: {...} }) — a NEW edit mode on the existing modal: same UI, prefilled state, submit calls customJS.TaskInteractions.replaceTaskAt instead of the create-path. NEW <!-- TODAY_CAPTURE_MARKER --> sentinel ships in Today To-Do.md (and is back-injected into existing daily notes by install.js step 6) so TaskInteractions.findTaskLines has a stable anchor for the editable-list scope. Depends_on +1 task-interactions@>=0.1.0. Click-to-edit is shipped only for Today's daily Capture in v0.12.0; ProjectTo-Do + meetings Action Items remain on file-open-with-edit-in-place semantics (deferred).

post_install.message: To-do blueprint v0.4.0 installed at spice/to-do/. Daily To-Do note now has 5 sections (Capture / Carryover from yesterday / Recurring Today / Open Project Tasks / Meeting Tasks). NEW: spice/to-do/Recurring Tasks.md registry for recurring task templates. NEW per-project To-Do notes at spice/projects/<slug>/<Name> To-Do.md (scaffolded by the project blueprint backfill). Use the +New Task button or palette command 'Sauce: New task' to capture tasks. Use +Recurring or 'Sauce: New recurring task' for the registry. Migrate-to-tomorrow modal is retired; use [scheduled:: YYYY-MM-DD] instead.
